overloadMerges.note: The two doc syntax lines differ only in whether the leading '*' is passed (selecting whether object is a name-string vs. a Variable/Field reference); collapsed into one overload with an optional literal-symbol discriminator. Also corrected direction on out-parameters (doc arrow column shows them as command outputs, not inputs) which the mechanical parser had defaulted to 'in'.

params.name: asObjectName
params.description: If present, object below is the name of the form object (string); if omitted, object is a variable or field reference.

params.name: object
params.description: Object name or "" to designate the form (if * is specified), orVariable or field (if * is omitted)

sentinelValues.meaning: Together with asObjectName ('*') present, designates the current form itself (retrieve form-level events) rather than a specific object.

overloadMerges.semanticRole: The OBJECT GET EVENTS command gets the current configuration of the form events for the object(s) designated by the object and * parameters.

constraints: To get events for a subform related to a table, only the object-name ('*') syntax may be used, not the Variable/Field syntax.
arrEvents is returned empty if no object method is associated with the object (or no form method, when object designates the form).
